Subsystem.name: WAD_Management
Subsystem.Description: Manages WAD file loading, directory lump hashing, file handles, and byte-order handling for multi-platform compatibility.

Subsystem.name: Video_And_Rendering
Subsystem.Description: Pure software rendering pipeline maintaining exact 35fps fixed-point accuracy. Handles column/span drawing, wall clipping, and sprite projection.

Subsystem.name: Game_Loop_And_Tick
Subsystem.Description: Deterministic 35 Hz game tick engine managing player inputs, map object (mobj) thinkers, sector triggers, and physics collision detection.

Subsystem.name: Networking_And_Multiplayer
Subsystem.Description: Original packet serialization and tick synchronization loop. Designed for modern C# refactoring into an authoritative client-server architecture suitable for cloud containers.
